The story

The Hamilton Jazzmaster Open Heart has been a notable part of the brand's collection for many years, blending American design spirit with Swiss mechanical precision. Early generations of the Open Heart were powered by the reliable ETA 2824-2 automatic movement. A significant turning point for the family was the transition to the Hamilton H-10 caliber, a proprietary movement based on the Swatch Group's Powermatic 80, which notably increased the power reserve to 80 hours. This evolution marked a move towards more technically advanced, in-house modified movements while retaining the signature design that allows the wearer to see the balance wheel and escapement in action. The collection has also expanded over time to include a variety of case sizes, including 36mm, 40mm, and 42mm, to appeal to a wider audience.
